description:
Found while sweeping the numbered corpus for fz-kdt.155 (base e132fe768 and after the fix behave identically, so this is unowned and pre-existing).

  fz2 run fixtures2/00429_external_impl_residual.fz

fails on every native door with

  error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]: compiler2 native lowering for root 0:
  native attempted to materialize absent value as runtime value with ty Some(Ty(34))
  in Continuation { owner: FnId(0), index: 1 }
  ... backend value ValueId(2) ... must be runtime-materializable; value=Absent

The fixture is a protocol with an Integer impl called over a [7, 1.0] list, so
the Float arm has no impl and stays a residual stub. Its only consumer,
port_planner_test::external_provider_protocol_impl_stays_as_stub_fallback,
drives the compiler and DISCARDS the result with a comment calling it a
'pre-existing pipeline gap for external protocol impl dispatch', plus a TODO
naming the dispatch-matrix shape it should assert. So the gap is recorded in a
comment nobody will look at again, which is what this ticket replaces.

Sibling of fz-kdt.77 / fz-kdt.149 (00424_protocol_no_impl panics inside product
materialization): same family -- a protocol call with no reachable impl should
DIAGNOSE, not reach native lowering with an absent value.
title: [BUG] 00429_external_impl_residual cannot be compiled: native lowering hits an Absent value in a continuation
